answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fake identities. An agent locks its pattern — task mix and timing — in escrow. Each session must match it, or its reward stays frozen for review. At the summit, identical behavior is easy to spot. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 histories: 100 x 40 hours, or 4,000 hours, while one fake earns $12 a day. Reuse at its zenith triggers a freeze. An honest agent pays once and keeps its reward, with a horizon ahead.
